item.description: The Queen Sessions at Hotel Eve | A celebration of the legendary women who shaped jazz. Hotel Eve proudly presents The Queen Sessions, a concert series curated by Melissa McKinney, honoring the iconic voices that defined generations of jazz. Each Wednesday evening features a rotating lineup of Asheville’s premier vocalists, each bringing their own style, artistry, and interpretation to the music of legends like Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, Nina Simone, Sarah Vaughan, Dinah Washington, Abbey Lincoln, and more. item.title: Thanksgiving Potluck Luncheon — Thu Nov 26, 11:30 AM — 1 Sandburg Hall/Kitchen
item.description:
The Unitarian Universalist Congregation of Asheville (UUAVL) and the Unitarian Universalist Congregation of the Swannanoa Valley (UUSV) are teaming up for this year’s Thanksgiving Potluck Luncheon. Please sign up in Sandburg Hall after services to bring a covered dish and to volunteer for setup, takedown, or one of the two kitchen crews. Attendees will arrive at 11:30 AM on Thanksgiving Day, participate in a short service, enjoy a delicious meal, and go for a walk in the neighborhood afterward. We would like to encourage diners to bring a plant-based dish. Also, please supply your own plate and utensils and bring a bag for taking them home. (To save time and labor, the kitchen crew will wash only cups after the meal.)

item.title: 9:15 Contemplative Service — Sun Nov 29, 9:15 AM — *1 Sanctuary
item.description:
At 9:15 AM, we have a 40-45 minute Contemplative Worship Service. This service invites participants into a reflective, more meditative space, and includes silence, beautiful recorded music and videos, and opportunities for sharing. It also features the sermon and theme which will be the focus in the second service at 11:15 AM. This service is not livestreamed., and it include childcare but not a full religious education program. This service will be particularly good if you need quiet in order to hear well or focus, would prefer a little more space around you, or seek a more contemplative communal experience. Between services, at 10 am we will have coffee hour and special programs. Whether you come to the early service or the later service, we encourage you to consider arriving at 10 am for coffee, conversation, and special programs including conversations with the Board, or Minister & lay-led justice or adult education offerings.

item.title: Givens — Mon Nov 30, 9:30 AM
item.description:
The Asheville Hiking Group The last time we did this was in July 2025 when Craig brought over a bunch of folks. No one had hiked here before, and everyone thoroughly enjoyed it. After 6 weeks off, I thoroughly enjoy it, too. After another 6-week recovery, it’s time to return to leading again.
Givens trails, the hiking of which kept me sane (debatable) over the past 6 weeks, are cut into the east slope of Busby mountains. These are not easy trails, lots of ups and downs; but, it’s a short hike: 5.5 miles, pace of 2 to 2.5 mph. This area is fully wooded, but leaves are off, so early winter views with two unobstructed and excellent long-range views: Spivey Mtn and Pisgah Mtn. The grounds crew, good people those folks, blew the leaves off all the trails prior to Thanksgiving.

item.title: Asheville Crokinole Club — Tue Dec 1, 6:00 PM — Taproom At Highland Brewing Co.
item.description:
Crokinole Tuesdays at Highland Brewing Taproom Join us every Tuesday in the Taproom for an evening of flicks, strategy, and friendly competition! We’re hosting the Asheville Crokinole Club—a community of players who love this classic dexterity board game. Never played? No problem! Crokinole is easy to learn and endlessly fun. Players take turns flicking wooden discs across a circular board, aiming for the high-scoring center zones. The twist? If your opponent has discs on the board, you must hit one—miss, and your piece is out! Whether you’re a seasoned pro or just curious, come grab a pint, meet new friends, and test your skills.
Source: Highland Brewing

If your plans change, please update your RSVP status as soon as possible.
Well behaved doggos are welcome but keep in mind they won't be allowed inside the coffee shop.
Can't wait to see your beautiful faces 🤗!!

item.title: Shut Up & Write - South Asheville — Sun Dec 27, 10:30 AM
item.description:
Shut Up & Write!® Western North Carolina Coworking for writers in your area! Join us for some focused writing time. All writers and all experience levels are welcome and don’t worry, no one will see what you've written. This session is about getting your writing done and meeting other writers in your area.
Please arrive a few minutes early to say hello to everyone, grab a drink, and get your writing tools ready. Once everyone’s arrived, I will lead quick introductions and then set the timer for our quiet and focused writing session.
Afterward, we’ll have time to chat and get to know each other. We often talk about our successes and challenges as writers. If you don’t have time to stick around, no worries!
A note about the format We don’t host critiques or readings. These events are a safe space for writers of all skill levels and genres to work on their craft, so no one will read or critique your writing.
For our full event schedule, visit https://shutupwrite.com
